learning_outcomes.text: Identifies, defines, formulates and solves Mechanical Engineering problems.
Applies modeling techniques with appropriate engineering methods.
Experimentally / numerically designs, builds, collects data, analyzes and interprets results.
Has the ability to write and present effective reports in accordance with the spelling rule.

syllabus_topics: Evaluation of the results and report writing
Preliminary preparation to make a presentation in front of the jury.
